snippet.description:
People have been talking a lot about the male loneliness crisis. But Tyler Austin Harper, staff writer for The Atlantic, makes the case that the men shouldn’t be afraid of  emotionally-shallow friendships. In fact, his fishing buddies fulfill his friendship needs, even though they don’t talk about their feelings. 

Hear more about it on Explain it To Me, wherever you get your podcasts.
